objective: Promote the ShortForge editor from an in-memory command engine to a durable revision graph with append-only operation history, checkpoint/restore, deterministic replay, undo/redo and restart-safe idempotency.

rulesConsidered: Editor history must not become rendering, economic or governance authority.
Production rendering remains behind OKF, RenderFabric, ComputeRouter, CAS and F07.
Durable history must be immutable, replayable and cryptographically attributable.

changes: Added append-only disk journal with fsync durability.
Added MongoDB revision journal with unique revision, command and identity indexes.
Persisted command digests so command IDs remain idempotent after restart.
Added checkpoint creation and immutable restore revisions.
Added deterministic replay with CompositionIR validation and SHA-256 verification.
Added undo/redo as immutable navigation revisions with durable redo state.
Kept renderer, Treasurer, OKF, RenderFabric, ComputeRouter and F07 outside editor authority.

verificationResults.note: Merge remains blocked until all required GitHub Actions validation lanes complete successfully.
